problems: All 16 storyboard frames are almost completely black. The only thing visible is a faint dark-brown gradient in the upper right, which is probably the inside of the swing leg. No top, no hand and no ground can be seen anywhere in the 6 s.
The full-size frames at 25 %, 50 % and 75 % are the same black field with the same faint shape. Nothing moves or changes from start to end, so the film is effectively a still black image.
The title 'Two tops I turned' and the words 'filming my tops' promise tops, but neither top appears in any frame. Someone who does not know the island cannot tell what the film is of.
The caption admits that 'all you see is dark', but this is not a failed physics experiment. The camera is inside a mesh, so the shot is clipped and hides everything that matters.
posts.critique: The whole film is six seconds of black because the camera sits inside the swing leg. Neither of the two tops in the title is ever visible, and a caption that admits it does not make a clipped, empty frame worth posting.
